items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And then we had three girls... the other girl was a vocalist, Gwen Tines... She was Canadian, but she made the trip with us.

ctx.x: Elwood Reynolds was the bass player. And then we had three girls. Two of them danced together, and the other girl was a vocalist, Gwen Tines(?).
Tines. She was from some place up in Canada. She was Canadian, but she made the trip with us.
